description: Collect Naver Place visitor reviews, linked Naver Blog posts, and aggregated rating statistics. Provide place URLs/IDs directly, or search by keyword to discover places first.

excludeReviewIds.description: Visitor review IDs and blog post URLs to skip. Useful for incremental runs that only want new reviews.
excludeReviewIds.title: Exclude review IDs or blog URLs

includeBlogReviews.description: Collect Naver Blog and cafe posts linked to the place, with exact publish dates.
includeBlogReviews.title: Include blog reviews

includeRatingOnlyReviews.description: Also collect reviews that have a star rating but no written text. These come from a separate Naver review stream and count toward maxReviews.
includeRatingOnlyReviews.title: Include rating-only reviews

includeReviewPhotos.description: Include photo and video-thumbnail URLs attached to each visitor review.
includeReviewPhotos.title: Include review photos

includeReviewStats.description: Emit one stats record per place: average rating, rating distribution, themes, top menus, voted keywords, and review counts.
includeReviewStats.title: Include review statistics

includeVisitorReviews.description: Collect visitor reviews. Turn off for a blog-only or stats-only run.
includeVisitorReviews.title: Include visitor reviews

maxBlogReviews.description: Maximum linked blog/cafe posts per place. Naver exposes at most 100 per place.
maxBlogReviews.title: Max blog reviews per place

maxConcurrency.description: How many places to scrape in parallel. Higher is faster but increases rate-limit risk.
maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent places

maxItems.description: Hard cap on total records emitted across all places.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPlacesPerKeyword.description: Maximum places to scrape per keyword search. Naver's search page returns up to 100 places per keyword.
maxPlacesPerKeyword.title: Max places per keyword

maxReviews.description: Maximum visitor reviews to collect per place, across both the text-review stream and the rating-only stream. Naver paginates 50 reviews per request.
maxReviews.title: Max visitor reviews per place

placeUrls.description: Naver Place URLs, naver.me short links, or bare numeric Place IDs. Examples: 'https://map.naver.com/p/entry/place/38239053', 'https://pcmap.place.naver.com/place/38239053/home', '38239053'.
placeUrls.title: Place URLs or IDs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Leave empty to use direct requests; the actor escalates to an Apify datacenter proxy only after a real block.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchKeywords.description: Keywords to discover places first, then scrape their reviews. Example: ['강남 맛집', '홍대 카페']. Can be combined with placeUrls.
searchKeywords.title: Search keywords

visitedSince.description: Only keep visitor reviews whose visit date is on or after this date. Reviews without a visit date are skipped when this filter is set.
visitedSince.title: Visited since (YYYY-MM-DD)

title: Naver Place Reviews + Blog Scraper Input
